title: Urological Supply Program — No-Charge Replacement Terms
content:
Summit Ridge ships at no charge, without billing coverage and without counting toward the monthly limits, in four cases tied to one original line of the Urological Supply Program:

- a **product switch** of brand or size within the program's product switch window of the first shipment;
- a **manufacturer defect** reported within the program's defect replacement window;
- a **carrier-lost** shipment unconfirmed after the program's lost package trace period in business days;
- a **wrong item**.

An original line receives at most one no-charge replacement per reason. Opened sterile catheters are never otherwise returned or exchanged.

## The four cases at a glance

| Reason | Condition | Unit of the window |
|---|---|---|
| product switch | one brand or size switch within the product switch window after the first shipment | calendar days |
| manufacturer defect | defect reported within the defect replacement window after shipment | calendar days |
| carrier lost | shipment without delivery confirmation after the lost package trace period | business days |
| wrong item | the wrong item was shipped | none |

## Effect of a replacement

- Coverage is not billed for the replacement.
- The replacement does not count toward any monthly limit.
- The replacement names the one original line it replaces and its reason.

## One replacement per line and reason

The evidence is the shipment record: no-charge replacement lines and the original line and reason each one names.

| Earlier no-charge replacement on the same original line | Effect |
|---|---|
| none | this limit does not prevent a replacement |
| one, for the same reason | no second replacement for that reason |
| one, for a different reason | this limit does not prevent a replacement for the new reason |

*Hypothetical case:* a leg bag line was replaced once as carrier lost. A later report that the items of that same original line are defective is a different reason and is not stopped by the one-per-reason limit; a second carrier-lost replacement of the same original line is.
